marta: 🎉 Big update — Evergreen Retail just went live with SmartShelf using our Embed SDK + Redwood Private. They signed a 12-month dedicated commitment (initial $180k ARR) and listed the integration in AppMarket. Huge thanks to @sara for the onboarding runbook and @ryan for the runtime tweaks.

josh: Incredible news, congrats team! Do we have a customer quote or permission to share a short case study externally?

marta: They approved a short quote from their CPO: "Redwood made integrating high-throughput recommendations into our POS painless — sub-200ms tail latencies are gamechanging." Marketing can use that. Need a one-page case study + 2 screenshots.

sara: Onboarding summary: private VPC deployment, HSM integration for keys, custom quantization profile for our workload, and KV-prefix caching tuned for 8-12 token prefix reuse. Rollout checklist we used:
```
1) Provision Private control plane + VPC peering
2) Setup KMS/HSM and rotate keys
3) Apply quant profile: q4_8b_opt
4) Enable prefix-KV cache (ttl=48h)
5) Smoke test at 25 TPS for 10m
```

ryan: Runtime notes — made two small kernel selections for their model (attention tiling + reduced mem-copy path). Staging perf: p50 80ms / p95 160ms at sustained 25 tps. No reliability issues during ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: evergreen-prod deploy complete at 2025-06-12T14:24Z :rocket: 

josh: Awesome — let's get a case study + short webinar scheduled. @sara can you draft the one-pager? I'll loop in Sales and Customer Success for a joint customer reference call.

sara: Will have a draft by EOD Fri. Need screenshots and a short architecture diagram from @ryan.

marta: Love it. Also flagging this as a referenceable win for our EU push — Evergreen plans EU expansion in Q3, they'll likely request region pinning.

ryan: Happy to produce diagram + perf graphs. I'll drop artifacts in the partnership folder.

marta: Thanks all — small celebration next week for the Partnerships + Solutions crew? :tada:

josh: Count me in :thumbsup:

sara: me too :smile:

marta: Closing note: this one unlocks potential ISV pipeline with 3 other retail customers already in talk. More updates soon.
